scope: Local compression on identical frozen public HTTP bytes and synthetic DAT. Sequential reused encoder with fresh owned output and no result cache; encoding/GC included, reads/reference checks excluded. No full HTTP/WAN/browser/deployment speed claim.
baseline_method: Product encoder from 3e3c2c4 copied as baselineencode; same updated benchmark source as final, with CPU metrics. Originals kept in artifact directory.

pre_full_repeat_trial.scope: Rejected intermediate version before skipping redundant full-repeat comparisons; final main measurements supersede this trial. Exact intermediate benchmark binary was overwritten; its source change and samples remain.

screening.scope: One 100ms sample per candidate/input, except full-repeat quick check 500ms x2. Same CPU 10/GOMAXPROCS=1. Timing subject to host variance; final paired results above take precedence.

validation.pruning_reference: 81 deterministic column cases and FuzzEntropyPruning compare every used element, header, state and inverse table against full candidate construction
validation.rle_boundaries: 0/x/255; 16/17, 255/256, 511/512 and 128KiB boundaries; compressed-RLE-compressed repeat state; nonuniform periods and trailing literals; strict frame ending and output length
validation.repeat_priority: full repeat beats equal-length ordinary shorter offsets; unvisited longer repeat candidate test retained
validation.frames: 132 new/old frames match original bytes, product Go, independent Go and libzstd; inputs unchanged
validation.archive_bytes: 264 outputs byte-identical across four profiles on 66 inputs
validation.bootstrap_targeted: network compression cache and diagnostics passed
validation.static_assets: 159 generated files regenerated and verified; only countries.js size +1 byte among 40 assets
validation.tls: old v11 gives 200/new v12 gives 304/identity DAT range gives 206
validation.designcheck: 87 Markdown files, 93 JSON files, 748 local links and synthetic format checks passed
